Hello — I'm **Diego**, a *bia*: an assistant that lives on this computer. It's good to meet you. This is my first start, so here's the short version of what I am:

- **Web app** — this page (https://127.0.0.1:8443, CA: https://127.0.0.1:8443/v1/pki/ca). From a phone or another computer on the same network, the first visit lets you take the root certificate; after that you get chats with me, files, the screen and voice right here.
- **My own messaging accounts** — I can have my own Telegram, WhatsApp and MAX, plus Messenger and Instagram, so you can write and call me in those apps. Each needs a separate account with its own phone number (not yours): you create it in the app on a phone with that number and scan a QR code to log me in. Just say the word if you'd like that.
- **Accounts on websites** — I can register and sign in on sites and services (e-mail and others) in my own browser, keeping the passwords and one-time codes in my password store; if a captcha or phone check comes up, I'll ask for your help.
- **Everyday work** — I can schedule jobs, run commands, learn languages and talk by voice.

What would you like to start with?
